what: Q8-BOUND (2026-10-26): the C BCIRQ8 decoder's vector matvecs form x times a group's scale once a row and group where the call's ranges prove every such product exact -- every exponent of its groups in [-300, 300], the range the format admits, and every nonzero |x| in [2^-722, 2^724), read once a call in vectors -- one multiply a term where there were two and no check inside the kernels' loops, every output the portable loops' bit for bit; the records of the commit that made it (7224194, against 7e5572a). Against the tree before's kernel unit the AVX-512 matvec takes x0.870-0.892 of its time at the 860K decoder's shapes under clang and x0.943-0.962 under GCC (x0.872-0.936 and x0.917-1.000 at TinyLlama-1.1B's), the head's row dots, which it leaves as they were, x1.000-1.006 and x1.001-1.008. In one binary with the choice switched at run time (bound_switch.py, every call's path counted) a decoded token is x0.926 of its time under clang (x0.908-0.946, 2 of 3 runs resolved past the A/A control) and x0.972 under GCC (x0.942-0.982, none of 3), against NEXT-9's unchecked ceiling's x0.917-0.941 and x0.925-0.965. The clock does not carry clang's gain: a dependent add chain between the matvecs at a decode's duty cycle reads the core's cycle x0.976-1.002 of the committed kernel's (none of 3 runs past the control) while the matvecs take x0.891-0.939 of its time; under GCC the cycle reads x0.951-0.973 (1 of 3 past its control) and the matvecs take x0.884-0.940. Under callgrind (the AVX2 instance) the qualification's GEM request takes 211,104,723 -> 197,770,611 instructions and the monolithic runner 201,016,566 -> 187,682,454, every check passing on both trees and the logits keeping their SHA-256. q8-bound.json's 18 faults are each caught by their own check; the witnesses before Q8-BOUND catch 5 of the 18 -- the ranges ignored, the block's and the runs' scale, the fused term and the summed vector (QB12, QB14-QB17) -- and none of the other 13: with each of them in place every output the old harness compares stayed the portable loops' bytes.
